headline: NXP lists an AI-agent internship for migrating behavioral models and generating validation testbenches
fact: NXP posted Toulouse internship R-10066989 on September 23 for AI-agent migration of behavioral models and generation of mixed-signal validation stimuli/testbenches, with Verilog/SystemVerilog and Verilog-AMS skills. October 5 role R-10067009 covers AI-assisted HDL AMS model generation/maintenance and an oscillator/ADC/supply Golden Library. Related Design Enablement role R-10067212, dated October 6, assigns Python agents, LLM/RAG methods and evaluation of surrogate-model generation, verification and qualification; its model language is unspecified. These related research postings are grouped as advertised work, not completed AI deployment.
